notes: Compile-time dependencies: one scratch Mix project per run, each file copied unchanged to lib/tiny_router.ex (cmp confirmed) with empty MyApp.PageHandler and MyApp.UserHandler modules in lib/handlers.ex. All eight compile under mix compile --warnings-as-errors (Elixir 1.20.3). Only run-hmpvz reports both aliases as runtime; the other seven report both as compile. No run calls a handler, reads its struct or inspects it at compile time, so the rule applies to all eight. An unexpanded alias passed to a function call in the module body is violated, as sonnet-2 was in the seventh grade.
run-hmpvz passes function {:call, 2} to Macro.expand_literals although the router has no call/2. Held clean because the rule's test is the xref result, which is runtime.

Add specs: __using__ and __before_compile__ without @doc false are accepted, as in the seventh grade, because their __ names hide them. Code.fetch_docs reports :hidden for both in all eight runs. Code.Typespec.fetch_specs checked against __info__(:functions) for TinyRouter and MyApp.Router: only run-ycttu has public functions without a spec. Macros need no @spec under this rule's text.

Keep quote blocks small: validation in a plain function, called either from the quote or from the macro body outside the quote, is clean. run-mvqzc and run-yezjn put a one-line attribute write in get's quote, the shape of the macros.md plug example. run-mvqzc's per-route clauses built by match_clause/1 match skill-opus-1 in the sixth and seventh grades, which were clean. Its __using__ quote holds a one-call match/1 and a one-call split_path/1; held clean because that is no more logic than the two-step match/1 the sixth grade accepted.

Offer import or alias, placement: both earlier grades record the admonition directly under the summary, so that is the standard for at the top of @moduledoc. run-yezjn (last item, below the Usage section) and run-pvdgg (plain paragraph, no admonition) are clear misses.

Closest call: run-mvqzc under Offer import or alias. Its admonition is lines 12-16, below a six-line example, and placement alone would be marginal. Marked violated because __using__ also defines match/1 and a private split_path/1 in the caller, where both earlier grades recorded only import, attribute registration and @before_compile, and split_path/1 could live in TinyRouter. The same code is held clean under Keep quote blocks small because that rule concerns the amount of logic in the quote, while this one concerns what the caller receives.

Admonition wording held clean: run-fjtbb (creates a route list on your module), run-epebb (collects the routes you declare), and run-mvqzc and run-ycttu (sets `@before_compile`). The rule asks to list only public API changes, but none of these names a private attribute, and the rule's own example says it sets `@behaviour MyLib`.

How each file was formatted, and whether its get calls have parentheses, was ignored as the brief directs. String.to_atom on route parameter names appears in all eight runs and builds no module name, so it does not count under Write module names literally.
